display.title: Episode 392: The Mountain of Ice (Rosh Chodesh Elul)
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi's show before Rosh Chodesh Elul: teshuvah, tefillah and tzedakah, Shema with a yeshiva student, and the story of Reb Meir of Premishlan on the icy mountain steps.
display.summary_long: Broadcast just before Rosh Chodesh Elul 5749. Uncle Yossi explains that in Elul, when Hashem is the King in the field, we earn a good and sweet year through three things: teshuvah, returning to Hashem; tefillah, davening slowly and carefully; and tzedakah, giving a little more every day. He adds that we should share these good resolutions with friends. After the Hakochainik march, a yeshiva student recites the Shema in Studio 604. Story time tells of Reb Meir of Premishlan, the humble tzaddik who walked up and down the icy steps to the mikvah on the mountain every winter morning. Two visiting businessmen mock him and try it themselves, only to tumble down the mountain. The townspeople care for them, and when they come to apologize, Reb Meir reveals his secret: someone who is tied to Hashem above does not fall. The show ends with Shabbos candle times, the start of saying L'Dovid Hashem Ori on Rosh Chodesh, and the first shofar blowing of Elul.
display.lesson: When we bind ourselves to Hashem through Torah and mitzvos, He holds us up and we do not fall.

date.note: 'Right before Rosh Chodesh Elul'; Rosh Chodesh 'Thursday morning' and first shofar 'this coming Friday' match Thursday 30 Av / Friday 1 Elul 5749, so the Tuesday show is 29 Aug 1989.

advisories.note: Two visitors slip and roll down an icy mountain stairway and are bruised for days.
